# Install this file with --no-deps to skip pip's resolver:
#     pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt
# The pins here come from a frozen `pip freeze` and contain a few mutually
# incompatible version constraints that pip's resolver would refuse to install.
# Skipping the resolver matches the env state on the maintainer's machine.
#
# If a sdist build fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pkg_resources'`:
# your pip pulled setuptools >= 81 into the isolated build env, which dropped
# pkg_resources. Recover with:
#   pip install "setuptools<81"
#   pip install <failed-pkg>==<ver> --no-build-isolation
# then re-run `pip install --no-deps -r requirements.txt`.
